name: Cable Decline Bench Press
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a decline between two low pulleys and hook your feet securely under the pads.
Lie back holding a handle beside each side of your lower chest with forearms roughly vertical.
Press the handles up and slightly together above your lower chest until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower both handles under control until your elbows return beside your torso.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades pressed flat against the pad.
Stack your wrists over your elbows and stop before the cables pull your arms too far behind your chest.
